root_cause.text: In `qla_fab_async_scan`, a `srb_t` structure (`sp`) is not freed when the scan is already active (`SF_SCANNING` flag set), causing a memory leak that leads to a system crash upon module unload due to lingering slab objects.
root_cause.evidence: The patch changes the error path from a direct `return rval;` to `goto done_free_sp;` after the check `if (vha->scan.scan_flags & SF_SCANNING)`. The `done_free_sp` label (implied by context) would free `sp`. The commit message and log show the crash was caused by objects remaining in the `qla2xxx_srbs` slab cache when `kmem_cache_destroy` was called during module exit, which matches a memory leak of `sp` in this error path.
